cards.hint: Think about uniqueness in the opening sentence
cards.quote: the value of one variable in a problem depends uniquely on the value of another variable in the problem.
cards.stem: What phrase describes how one variable relates to another in a function

cards.quote: The trigonometric functions sine, cosine, and tangent relate the various sides and angles of a triangle.
cards.stem: Which group is said to relate sides and angles of a triangle

cards.hint: Check the sentence about the black triangle ratio
cards.quote: For the black triangle, the cosine of “b” is equal to x divided by y.
cards.stem: For the black triangle, what is the cosine equal to

cards.hint: Focus on what stays fixed when sides grow
cards.quote: The value of cosine “b” just depends on the value of “b” and not the length of the sides that form “b”.
cards.stem: What determines the cosine value when triangle size changes
